reason: ip-address@10.7.2 is bundled inside npm (pinned to 11.21.1 through the @semantic-release/npm override), so an override cannot replace it, and no npm release yet bundles the patched 10.7.4 (npm 12.2.1 still ships 10.7.2). Inside npm only socks uses it, to parse a SOCKS proxy address; the release job configures no proxy, so it never parses untrusted input. Remove once an npm release bundles ip-address >=10.7.4.
